title: Entity
description: A real registered legal company. One entity per file in entities/.

name.description: The exact registered legal name, including the legal form.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country of registration.

parent.description: id of the entity that owns this one, or null if it is the ultimate parent.

lei.description: GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier: 20 characters, last two are check digits.

registry_id.description: National company register number, as printed by the register.

sources.description: Where this record was checked. At least one must be a URL anyone can open.

verified_on.description: ISO 8601 date on which a human last checked this record against its sources.

example.description: true if this file is a seeded template rather than curated data.
